3661-5006-5256-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
3661-5006-5256-8170.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shield Sphere, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5007-6495-6972.description:
If Morselhoarder has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Morselhoarder has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
5007-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

624-5011-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Repeat.
624-5011-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

323-1981-2034-2415.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1742-5003-6797-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
1742-5003-6797-7848.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat step 4 three additional times.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
1742-5003-6797-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card.

2557-3129-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

855-3099-4762-7741.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Corpsejack Menace and Shang-Chi.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

188-6500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible.
188-6500.description:
Activate Tephraderm by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Tephraderm triggers, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1409-2933-5434-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1409-2933-5434-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1624-1860-7439.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Emergence Zone by paying {1}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, allowing you to cast spells as though they had flash this turn.
Cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

5070-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5070-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

560-2292-4550-7256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2292-4550-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Warhost's Frenzy triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Repeat from step 2

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

618-6558--112.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Naga Fleshcrafter that has haste. Choose to have Naga Fleshcrafter enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Naga Fleshcrafter token instead.
618-6558--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Naga Fleshcrafter's toughness.

2034-3490-5070-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-5070-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-4740-5220-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
2173-4740-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying X life, where X is the creature's mana value.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
2173-4740-5220-5686.notes: Your starting life total will need to be at least a certain number depending on the mana value of the creature you are sacrificing to perform this combo. This list shows the minimum life total you would need to have, from mana value 1 (left) to 10 (right): 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29, 37, 46, 56. You can also cast spells to reduce the needed life to start.

5220-5231-5651.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {R} or less.
5220-5231-5651.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2018-2292-6288.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

955-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
955-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

457-5487-5491.description:
Cast Molten Duplication by paying {1}{R}, creating a copy of Worldwalker Helm plus a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Worldwaker Helm and a Map, adding {U}{U}.
Activate a Worldwalker Helm by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the Worldwalker Helm token plus a Map token for each Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-5487-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

91-1365-1849-5112-5284.description:
Activate Mairsil using Cauldron of Souls' ability by tapping it, giving itself persist until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Mairsil dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Mairsil dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

643-1887-2060-3525-5121.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Urtet.
Urtet does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
643-1887-2060-3525-5121.description:
Activate Urtet by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, putting six +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, as they are all Myrs due to Maskwood Nexus.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Urtet.
Repeat.

409-2104-4211.description:
Activate Tormod's Crpyt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Deadbridge Chant triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can fail if other cards enter your graveyard after step 1.

608-1636-2034-4937.notablePrerequisites: Lumengrid Augur does not have summoning sickness.
608-1636-2034-4937.description:
Activate Lumengrid Augur by paying {1} and tapping it, causing an opponent to loot.
Xyris' first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
The Snake enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Snake, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1170-3200-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3200-5131.description:
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to look at a card in a player's hand, and then draw a card at the beginning of the next upkeep.
Cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Repeat.

1424-5153.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
1424-5153.description:
Activate Sunstrike Legionnaire by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

2047-2793-5192.notablePrerequisites: Mechanized Production attached to Ugin's Nexus.
2047-2793-5192.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production and Teferi's Realm trigger.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Put the token copy of Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Teferi's Realm trigger, causing Ugin's Nexus and Mechanized Production to phase out.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your untap step, Mechanized Production and Ugin's Nexus phase in.
Repeat.

110-3966.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
110-3966.description:
Gain life.
Marauding Blight-Priest triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Exquisite Blood triggers for each opponent that lost life.
Resolve a Exquisite Blood trigger, gaining 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

151-4694-5261.easyPrerequisites:
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-4694-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
151-4694-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat
